findings.detail: Commit 1f9f52d deliberately moved `startingPrices` from per-option-row to per-service counting (`serviceHasStartingPrice`), but `noPrice` was left incremented once per option row inside the same `for (const v of named)` loop (line 165), while the simple branch increments it once per service (line 178). The log line in `components/WebScraperTab.tsx:198` renders all four counts in one sentence anchored on services — `"1 services in 1 categories, …, 3 with no price"` is what a single priceless 3-variant service would print. Same mixed-unit defect the previous commit fixed, in the adjacent counter. No effect on the exported rows, only on the log the user reads to sanity-check the scrape.
findings.summary: stats.noPrice counts option rows while every sibling stat counts services

findings.detail: `handbooks/architecture/frontend-boundaries.md` § "What Rex flags" lists `fetch(` inside `components/**` as a trigger. Recording the match rather than silently dropping it: this occurrence is `fetchFreshaVenue(freshaVenue, (u, init) => fetch(u, init))` — the component calls a service (rule 2's prescribed path) and passes the browser global as a test seam; the request construction, headers, abort controller and error mapping all live in `services/freshaVenueService.ts`. It is byte-for-byte the same seam the pre-existing Yalla path uses at line 63, and the net effect of this diff is to move Fresha I/O out of the component, not into it. Treated as a false positive on the trigger pattern, not a rule-2 violation — no verdict effect.
findings.summary: fetch token appears in a component, as the injected transport for a service

findings.detail: The catch rewrites the error to `"The venue page did not answer within N s."` whenever `controller.signal.aborted` is true, regardless of what actually threw. If the response arrives just under the deadline and `parseFreshaVenueHtml` then returns null (or `res.text()` rejects) after the timer has fired, the user is told the page timed out when the real cause was missing `__NEXT_DATA__`. The window is milliseconds wide and both paths lead to the same page-text fallback, so there is no behavioural difference — only a misleading log line in a narrow race. Raising this above `info` would require the misreport to change what the user does, which it does not.
findings.summary: Any error raised after the abort timer fires is reported as a timeout
